title: Cargo Manifest Shuffle
description: A dockworker reading a manifest expects each crate to have one label and a consistent order. Enable "Duplicate ids" and "Random list order" on the Fleet & Scheduling board and see whether your test can still reliably find and drag one specific shipment card.
successCondition: With both "Duplicate ids" and "Random list order" switched on, a test loads /fleet, locates a specific shipment card by its visible route/content (not by row index or a bare id selector), and successfully drags it into a vehicle lane — repeated across two page reloads even though the row order and one row's id differ each time.
hints: Log in as a dispatcher or admin — the fleet board is dispatch-only.
With "Duplicate ids" on, the 2nd row in a lane shares its id with the 1st — scope your locator to the row's visible text/content instead of an id selector.
